name: Moonwood Mill
weather: Sunny most of the year, snowy winters, heat waves in summer, the odd thundersnowstorm

highlights.name: Local History
highlights.text: This former lumber mill town may be a bit quiet, but dig a little and you're sure to surface some secrets from the past... and present!

highlights.name: Natural Wonder
highlights.text: Surrounded by miles of wilderness and enriched by rare fauna and flora like the Luna Fish and Moonpetal Flower, Moonwood Mill is a nature-lover's paradise.

highlights.name: Mysterious Sightings
highlights.text: The mysterious silhouettes lurking in the wilderness' trees are enough to make any visitor's fur - erm, hair - stand on end.
